clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 1 on the MegaETH testnet (chain id 6343): every contract whose runtime equals build/PoolManager.json with the immutable masked, and the log census of that contract, with no Donate, ERC-6909 Transfer, Approval, OperatorSet or ProtocolFeeUpdated log.
clearedSpotChecks.note: On 2026-11-26 https://carrot.megaeth.com/rpc answered chain id 0x18c7, mega-reth/v2.3.1-4499c42@tnet-ash-rpc-0 and head 0x2253f27. eth_getCode of 0xea338f5d6065c384e4defd7784b59e9c36c94e4d returned 24,009 bytes with keccak 0x81600de1a33b19bc8e61a89ce429ad29fc0b1b35f5696789ccb041038be1ca47, as stated. One eth_getLogs over blocks 0 to latest at that address, with topic0 any of Donate 0x29ef05ca, ERC-6909 Transfer 0x1b3d7edb, Approval 0xb3fd5071, OperatorSet 0xceb576d9 and ProtocolFeeUpdated 0xe9c42593 (topics computed with tools/opdiff/evm.py keccak from the event signatures at src/interfaces/IPoolManager.sol:107, src/interfaces/external/IERC6909Claims.sol:10-14, src/interfaces/IProtocolFees.sol:23), returned an empty array, both for 0 to 28,860,720 and for 28,860,720 to latest. A control query for Initialize and OwnershipTransferred over the same range returned 7 logs (1 and 6), so the endpoint serves full-range queries at this address. The work file out/mega-tnet-pm-logs.json lists two 1,000,000 block ranges that hit the 50,000 result cap, but it holds logs from both of those ranges, and my own query does not depend on that split. The claim that the testnet producer never ran donate or any ERC-6909 mint to transfer path holds. Mints and burns show up only as Transfer logs, so the empty Transfer result covers them as well.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 3 for Monad: the testnet validators (v0.16.7) compile contracts under the same rule as mainnet (v0.16.5), because category/vm/vm.cpp is byte-identical and the default VM mode is Dual.
clearedSpotChecks.note: I fetched category/vm/vm.cpp and vm.hpp at tags v0.16.5 and v0.16.7 from raw.githubusercontent.com/category-labs/monad. Both vm.cpp files have sha256 cd3111877e1f6f5915022508eed071ae06b4ea0081c1299698c946776b4704da. The only difference between the two vm.hpp files is the added accessor `Mode mode() const { return mode_; }`. v0.16.7 vm.hpp:153 reads `explicit VM(Mode mode = Dual);`. https://docs.monad.xyz/developer-essentials/testnets names v0.16.7 and MONAD_TEN. https://docs.monad.xyz/developer-essentials/network-information names v0.16.5 and MONAD_TEN. The item already says which mode and release each validator actually runs is not public, and I found nothing that says otherwise. This item is the weakest of the three, but its stated limits are correct.
